seriesTitle: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic

episodes.title: Friendship is Magic - Part 1
episodes.summary: After trying to warn Princess Celestia about the return of the wicked Night Mare Moon, Twilight Sparkle and Spike travel to Ponyville where they meet Pinkie Pie, Applejack, Rainbow Dash, Rarity and Fluttershy.

episodes.title: Friendship is Magic - Part 2
episodes.summary: Twilight Sparkle and her new friends go on an adventure to stop Nightmare Moon's plan for never-ending nighttime. They must travel to the Castle of the Two Sisters and gather the Elements of Harmony.

episodes.title: The Ticket Master
episodes.summary: Twilight Sparkle decides on who to take to the pony gala, since she has an extra ticket. When the other ponies catch word, they pull out all the stops to convince her to take them.

episodes.title: Applebuck Season
episodes.summary: Applejack stubbornly vows to perform the orchard harvest herself, despite driving herself to disruptive exhaustion.

episodes.title: Griffon the Brush-Off
episodes.summary: A griffon friend of Rainbow Dash comes to visit, but proves to be a cruel bully.

episodes.title: Boast Busters
episodes.summary: When a smug magician comes to town, Twilight Sparkle resists her friends' calls to challenge her for fear of seeming like a show-off herself.

episodes.title: Dragonshy
episodes.summary: Fluttershy must overcome her fears to convince a dragon to move out of town before its plume of black smoke covers all the land.

episodes.title: Bats!
episodes.summary: Vampire Fruit Bats take over Sweet Apple Acres and Applejack and her friends' efforts to get rid of them take an unexpected and frightening turn.

episodes.title: For Whom the Sweetie Belle Toils
Make New Friends But Keep Discord
episodes.summary: When Discord learns that Fluttershy is taking a new friend to the Grand Galloping Gala instead of him, he goes to extreme lengths to prove that he isn't upset about it.

episodes.title: Do Princesses Dream of Magic Sheep?
Canterlot Boutique
episodes.summary: Rarity's dream of owning a boutique in Canterlot finally comes true, but it comes at a price Rarity may not be willing to pay.

episodes.title: Rarity Investigates!
episodes.summary: Rarity must prove that her friend is innocent when Rainbow Dash is accused of a crime that she did not commit.

episodes.title: Made in Manehattan
episodes.summary: Applejack and Rarity are called to Manehattan to solve a friendship problem; they find themselves helping Coco Pommel with a major project in her neighborhood, but the three soon discover that they've bitten off more than they can chew.

episodes.title: Brotherhooves Social
episodes.summary: When Applejack is called away and has to miss participating in the Sisterhooves Social with Apple Bloom, Big Mac decides to fill in for her.

episodes.title: Crusaders of the Lost Mark
episodes.summary: When Pip Squeak decides to run for class president, the Cutie Mark Crusaders rally around their friend, but find themselves helping their long-time nemesis, Diamond Tiara, in an unexpected way.

episodes.title: The One Where Pinkie Pie Knows
Hearthbreakers
episodes.summary: Applejack is excited to celebrate Hearthswarming Eve with Pinkie Pie's family but soon discovers that the Pies have very different ways of enjoying the holiday at their Rock Farm.

episodes.title: Scare Master
episodes.summary: Fluttershy decides to face her fears and take part in Nightmare Night with her friends.

episodes.title: What About Discord?
episodes.summary: Twilight returns from Canterlot to find her friends have developed a deep bond with Discord.

episodes.title: The Hooffields and Mccolts
episodes.summary: Princess Twilight and Fluttershy are called by the map to settle a dispute between two feuding families who can't even remember why they are fighting.

episodes.title: The Mane Attraction
episodes.summary: An old friend of Applejack's has become a huge pop star and Applejack fears that the singer's manager does not have her best interests at heart.

episodes.title: The Cutie Re-Mark - Part 1
episodes.summary: Starlight Glimmer returns to seek vengeance on Twilight and her friends and has acquired a spell that could change the past, present, and future of Equestria forever.

episodes.title: The Cutie Re-Mark - Part 2
episodes.summary: Princess Twilight's efforts to stop Starlight from altering the past continue, but she fears that they may be in vain.

episodes.title: Gauntlet of Fire
episodes.summary: Spike is forced to compete in a dangerous Gauntlet for the title of Dragon Lord in order to save his friends.

episodes.title: The Saddle Row Review
episodes.summary: When Rarity opens her flagship store in Manehattan, a tell-all article threatens to expose how badly her friends almost ruined the Grand Opening.

episodes.title: Flutter Brutter
episodes.summary: When Fluttershy tries to convince her freeloading brother to move out of their parents' house, he moves in with her instead, forcing Fluttershy to stand up to him and help him get over his fear of failure.

episodes.title: The Times They Are a Changeling
The Fault in Our Cutie Marks
episodes.summary: Pinkie Pie and Fluttershy turn out to be Ponyville's best buckball players; Applejack and Rainbow Dash agree to coach them against Appleoosa

episodes.title: Viva Las Pegasus
episodes.summary: Applejack and Fluttershy follow the map to Las Pegasus where they discover suspicious going-ons at a resort called Gladmane's; they also find Film and Flam working at the resort.

episodes.title: Every Little Thing She Does
episodes.summary: Though Starlight Glimmer is excelling at her magical studies with Twilight Sparkle, she feels pressure to impress her teacher and takes on too many friendship problems at once.

episodes.title: P.P.O.V. (Pony Point of View)
episodes.summary: Twilight must find the truth after Applejack, Rarity and Pinkie Pie have three different versions of events from their boat trip and are upset with each other.

episodes.title: Where the Apple Lies
episodes.summary: When Apple Bloom tells a white lie to cover up a mistake, Applejack shares the story of how she came to value honesty after telling a series of lies that almost destroyed the farm and landed the whole Apple family in the hospital.

episodes.title: Top Bolt
episodes.summary: The Cutie Map summons Twilight and Rainbow Dash to the Wonderbolt Academy to solve a friendship problem between academy hopefuls Sky Stinger and Vapor Trail.

episodes.title: To Where and Back Again - Part 1
episodes.summary: Without the assistance of Twilight Sparkle and the Mane Six, Starlight Glimmer must work alone to assemble an unlikely team of heroes to defend Equestria from the return of one of its greatest threats.

episodes.title: To Where and Back Again - Part 2
episodes.summary: To rescue her friends and save Equestria, Starlight Glimmer leads an unlikely band of heroes against one of the ponies' oldest and greatest foes.

episodes.title: A Flurry of Emotions
episodes.summary: Twilight Sparkle tries to prove she is the best aunt ever when she adds baby-sitting her niece, Flurry Heart, to her already busy schedule.

episodes.title: Rock Solid Friendship
episodes.summary: Pinkie Pie does everything she can to make sure her sister, Maud, sees that Ponyville has more to offer than just rocks.

episodes.title: Fluttershy Leans In
episodes.summary: Determined to make her career dreams come true with the help of some very special ponies, Fluttershy must find a way to stand up and fight for her ideas.

episodes.title: Forever Filly
episodes.summary: Rarity tries to surprise Sweetie Belle with a day filled with all of her favorite activities, but quickly learns her little sister is no longer the little foal she used to be.

episodes.title: Parental Glideance
episodes.summary: Rainbow Dash is pushed to the brink by her parents' unbridled enthusiasm after they learn she is a Wonderbolt.

episodes.title: Hard to Say Anything
episodes.summary: The CMC's figure out that Big Mac has his first crush and vow to help him win Sugar Belle's heart against the competition of Feather Bangs.

episodes.title: Honest Apple
episodes.summary: When Rarity asks Applejack to be a judge in a fashion show, Applejack learns that an opinion, however honest, can still be hurtful.

episodes.title: A Royal Problem
episodes.summary: Starlight Glimmer is sent to solve a friendship problem between Princess Celestia and Princess Luna; when it's clear that the problem is that the royal sisters don't appreciate one another, Starlight impulsively switches their cutie marks!

episodes.title: Not Asking for Trouble
episodes.summary: Pinkie Pie visits Prince Rutherford and the Yaks. While there, an avalanche falls on the entire rustic village of Yakyakistan. Pinkie Pie suggests that she go to get the other ponies to come help but the proud Prince and Yaks refuse.

episodes.title: Discordant Harmony
episodes.summary: When Discord invites Fluttershy to his realm for tea, he worries she won't be comfortable there and begins to change it and himself with disastrous results.

episodes.title: The Perfect Pear
episodes.summary: The Apple Siblings learn about their parent's love story and find out that they're half Pear.

episodes.title: Fame and Misfortune
episodes.summary: Twilight Sparkle's publishing of the friendship journal has unintended consequences when ponies start to argue over who wrote the best lessons.

episodes.title: Triple Threat
episodes.summary: Spike accidentally invites Ember and Thorax to Ponyville on the same day. He's sure the two new leaders are not going to get along so he does all he can to keep them apart and cover the fact that the other is there.

episodes.title: Campfire Tales
episodes.summary: When their sister camping trip is ruined by Fly-ders, Applejack, Rarity, and Rainbow Dash tell Sweetie Belle, Apple Bloom, and Scootaloo the stories of their favorite legends; inspired by the tales, the girls make the most out of their new situation.

episodes.title: It Isn't the Mane Thing About You
Marks and Recreation
episodes.summary: Wanting to help as many blank flanks as possible, the Cutie Mark Crusaders start a Cutie Mark Day Camp, but are surprised when one of their campers doesn't want a cutie mark!

episodes.title: Once Upon a Zeppelin
episodes.summary: Twilight is torn when she discovers the cruise she and her family are on is a themed vacation experience in which ponies have paid for the privilege of spending time with her, and she must please both her family and the cruise attendees.

episodes.title: Secrets and Pies
episodes.summary: When Pinkie Pie thinks she sees Rainbow Dash throw away one of her pies, she suspects the worst - that Rainbow Dash secretly hates her pies; Pinkie Pie attempts to catch Rainbow Dash in her web of lies.

episodes.title: Uncommon Bond
episodes.summary: When Starlight gets a visit from Sunburst, she discovers that he has tons in common with her friends and starts to wonder if he still has anything in common with her.

episodes.title: Shadow Play - Part 1
episodes.summary: When Sunburst discovers the lost journal of Starswirl the Bearded, Twilight becomes obsessed with saving her magical idol from a thousand-year-old prison.

episodes.title: Shadow Play - Part 2
episodes.summary: With Starswirl and the other Pillars of Old Equestria back from limbo (where they've been trapped for a thousand years), Twilight and her friends must work together to defeat the Pony of Shadows.

episodes.title: School Daze - Part 1
episodes.summary: When the Friendship Map grows bigger to reflect the world beyond Equestria, the Mane Six realize they'll need a way to spread the message of friendship far and wide. Luckily Twilight knows just what to do- open a School Of Friendship!

episodes.title: School Daze - Part 2
episodes.summary: When the School of Friendship is closed by Chancellor Neighsay of the Equine Educational Association, Twilight Sparkle must reunite her students, inspire her friends and buck the rules to stand up for what she knows is right for every creature, pony or not.

episodes.title: The Maud Couple
episodes.summary: Pinkie Pie's super-best-friend-sister bond is challenged when Maud gets a boyfriend that Pinkie Pie can't stand.

episodes.title: Fake It ‘Til You Make It
episodes.summary: When Fluttershy is the only pony available to look after the Manehattan boutique while Rarity is away, she takes on a series of characters to cope with the intimidating clientele and learns that she was already the best pony for the job just by being herself.

episodes.title: Grannies Gone Wild
episodes.summary: Granny Smith and her friends head to Las Pegasus. Rainbow Dash tags along as a chaperone so she can ride the best rollercoaster ever before it closes.

episodes.title: Surf and/or Turf
episodes.summary: With family members on Mount Aris and Sea Pony relatives in Seaquestria, the Cutie Mark Crusaders try to help a young Hippogriff figure out where he belongs.

episodes.title: Horse Play
episodes.summary: Twilight Sparkle casts Princess Celestia in her play, only to discover Celestia's talents lie elsewhere.

episodes.title: A Rockhoof and a Hard Place
The Beginning of the End - Part 1
episodes.summary: Princess Celestia and Princess Luna decide to retire and hand off the ruling of Equestria to Twilight Sparkle and her friends, which sends Twilight into a tailspin of self-doubt. Meanwhile, an ancient villain bands together a legion of nefarious characters to conquer all of Equestria, challenging Twilight Sparkle and the rest of the Mane 6 to step in and save the day.

episodes.title: The Beginning of the End - Part 2
Common Ground
episodes.summary: Rainbow Dash's old pal Quibble Pants needs help to bond with the daughter of his new special friend because, like Dash, she's a real sports pony.

episodes.title: She's All Yak
episodes.summary: When Sandbar asks Yona to a pony dance, she goes to Rarity and her friends for a makeover in appearance and personality.

episodes.title: Frenemies
episodes.summary: Grogar sends his legion of doom on a mission to become allies, but his plan works too well and they almost become friends.

episodes.title: Sweet and Smoky
episodes.summary: Smolder returns to the Dragonlands with Spike and Fluttershy to help cheer up her sensitive brother, but when they arrive they discover the dragon eggs aren't hatching.

episodes.title: Going to Seed
episodes.summary: Applejack's plans for an orderly harvest go awry when Apple Bloom becomes obsessed with catching a magical creature she thinks can help them.

episodes.title: Student Counsel
episodes.summary: Starlight Glimmer relishes her role as school counselor and encourages the students to come to her anytime about anything, but she becomes overwhelmed and learns a lesson.

episodes.title: The Last Crusade
episodes.summary: Unexpected visitors to Ponyville threaten to break up the Cutie Mark Crusaders forever.

episodes.title: Between Dark and Dawn
episodes.summary: Luna and Celestia take a sister vacation while Twilight and her friends struggle to cover the princesses' many royal duties.

episodes.title: Growing Up is Hard to Do
The Ending of the End - Part 1
episodes.summary: A villainous alliance unleashes their unified might on Equestria and it's up to the Mane Six to save the kingdom.

episodes.title: The Ending of the End - Part 2
The Last Problem
episodes.summary: Years later in the future, Princess Twilight is visited by a student with a friendship problem. As she attempts to solve it, she looks back on the times she and the Mane Six spent together.
